mostWorthwhile.text: The cold-response sequence was most worthwhile: the planned vessel and muscle insets distinguish reducing heat loss from producing heat through contractions.

leastWorthwhile.text: The warm sequence was a little prescriptive: the sweat goal suggested glands, but the game required the vessel step first.

surprise.text: The attempted sweat-gland combination automatically revealed and performed the skin-vessel step, showing another route for heat to reach the surface.

arbitrary.text: Requiring widened skin vessels before activating sweat glands felt like a game-imposed sequence; the supplied explanation shows their contributions but does not explain why one must precede the other.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the planned contrasting warm and cold responses make system connections understandable, although the sequence leaves limited room for meaningful choices.
